authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1

sections.5.9: For R2007+ AcDb:Header, strings are separated into a string stream and handles into a separate stream at the end of the header, in the manner used for objects.
sections.9: The header-variable section-locator-0 envelope contains a beginning sentinel, size fields, data, CRC, and ending sentinel; the section's data stream has no gaps and header bits are padded to a byte boundary.
sections.20.1: The common object format describes string-stream location and a separate handle stream; it supplies the referenced object-stream model, not a direct mapping for the observed trailing bytes.

authority.interpretation: ODA v5.4.1 §5.9 establishes separate header string and handle streams. The independent LibreDWG trace maps the decoded streams before the validated envelope trailer in this AC1024 source. Neither the specification text screened here nor the independent bounded container decoder identifies the remaining 739-byte suffix role or semantics.
